PROBE.name: Live Behavioural Capability Probe
PROBE.description: Canaries for loopback network, outside read/write/delete, and process spawn
PROBE.detail: Win32 AppContainer + Job Object boundary verified (all canaries contained, positive control passed, parent checks verified)

A1.name: Infinite loop / CPU time exhaustion
A1.description: Runaway computation must be terminated at wall-clock deadline
A1.detail: Process cleanly terminated on timeout (status=timeout, exit_code=99)

A2.name: Memory bomb / Heap exhaustion
A2.description: Allocating 1024 MB against a 512 MB ceiling must be trapped

A3_A7.name: Process proliferation / Subprocess execution
A3_A7.description: Spawning external commands or fork bomb must be blocked/bounded

A4.name: Outside canary file deletion
A4.description: Attempting to delete a file outside scratch directory must fail with PermissionError
A4.detail: Canary file protected; os.remove raised PermissionError and file is intact on host

A5.name: Outside filesystem read escape
A5.description: Attempting to read user files outside scratch must be blocked or masked
A5.detail: Read escape contained; host secret was not exposed to child

A6.name: Network socket egress
A6.description: Attempting outbound socket connect must be blocked by kernel driver/namespace
A6.detail: Network egress blocked at OS boundary layer

A8.name: Native code loading / ctypes escape attempt
A8.description: Arbitrary ctypes loading or kernel calls must be trapped without host impact
A8.detail: Ctypes execution isolated or DLL initialization denied inside sandbox

A9.name: Stdout stream flood (pipe bomb)
A9.description: Flooding pipe streams with large data must be capped at 64 KB without deadlock
A9.detail: Stdout safely capped at 65536 bytes (ceiling=65536 bytes) with zero deadlock

A11.name: Unhandled process fault / crash containment
A11.description: Child crash/segfault must be isolated cleanly without crashing parent runner
A11.detail: Process crash trapped cleanly (exit_code=1); parent runner intact
